checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

checks.name: recover_about_80ul
checks.detail: 70-90 uL of the 100 uL eluate, as the task's step 13 says; 48/48 sample wells

items.evidence: Failed check reservoir_columns_within_15ml: the ethanol split (etoh_cols[i%4] and [(i+1)%4]) draws 16000 uL from reservoir column 10, more than the 15 mL well holds.

The run-log check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips, no violations). Each p1000 sample tip and each p300 supernatant, wash-removal, elution and recovery tip is dropped per sample or column, and reagent-only tips never aspirate from sample wells.

All 14 steps are done in order with the right volumes and delays (5 min, 4 min, 4 min dry, 30 s, 90 s). The magnet is engaged for removals, the temperature module is set to 4 C first, and 80 uL is recovered.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed, and each of the 48 tubes goes to its own well in columns 1,3,5,7,9,11 (dest = sample_cols[i//8][i%8]), with 48 distinct elution wells.

The code adds 40 uL beads, then 250 uL isopropanol, then 250 uL sample with mix_after=(5,250). It then delays 5 min, engages the magnet for 4 min, and removes 2x270 uL to waste. Checks binding_volumes_40_250_250 and magnet_engaged_for_all_removals passed.
Two washes each add 2x250 uL ethanol and remove 2x250 uL with the magnet engaged, then there is a 4 min delay before mag.disengage(). Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed.
The code disengages the magnet, adds 100 uL elution buffer and mixes, waits 30 s, engages the magnet for 90 s, then transfers 80 uL to distinct wells of the 4 C elution plate.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the task steps faithfully and passes tip handling, sample mapping, binding, washes and elution. It fails robot_practice because the ethanol split draws 16 mL from reservoir column 10, which holds 15 mL.
